claim_recovery_table.claim: M33 X-7 excludes ULB masses in [3.1e-13, 4.2e-12] eV at 95% CL (conservative, combined modes)
claim_recovery_table.method: Monte Carlo estimate over 1838 posterior samples with Salpeter timescale cut

claim_recovery_table.claim: IRAS 09149-6206 excludes ULB masses in [1.8e-20, 3.7e-19] eV at 95% CL (aggressive, no timescale cut)
claim_recovery_table.method: Monte Carlo estimate over 10000 posterior samples without timescale cut

claim_recovery_table.claim: IRAS 09149-6206 conservative constraints peak at ~68% exclusion (no 95% CL)
claim_recovery_table.method: Conservative analysis with 1 Gyr timescale cut; large mass uncertainty limits constraint

claim_recovery_table.claim: Self-interactions weaken exclusion for f_a < ~10^14 GeV (M33 X-7, QCD axion)
claim_recovery_table.method: Bosenova shutdown criterion N_max > N_crit applied to each posterior sample
